migrations.name: update-angular-cli-version-20-2-0

migrations.description: Update the @angular/cli package version to ~20.3.0.
migrations.name: update-angular-cli-version-20-3-0

migrations.description: Updates webpack-based SSR configuration to use preserve module format and bundler module resolution.
migrations.name: update-ssr-webpack-config-22-2-0

migrations.description: Update 'module' to 'preserve' and 'moduleResolution' to 'bundler' in TypeScript configurations for Angular projects.
migrations.name: update-module-resolution-22-2-0

migrations.description: Updates the 'lib' property in tsconfig files to use 'es2022' or a more modern version.
migrations.name: update-typescript-lib-22-2-0

migrations.description: Update 'vitest' unit test runner option to 'vitest-analog' in generator defaults.
migrations.name: update-unit-test-runner-option

migrations.description: Set 'isolatedModules' to 'true' in TypeScript test configurations for Angular projects.
migrations.name: set-isolated-modules-22-3-0

migrations.description: Replace 'jest-preset-angular/setup-jest' imports with the new 'setupZoneTestEnv' function.
migrations.name: update-jest-preset-angular-setup

migrations.description: Update the @nx/angular/module-federation import to use @nx/module-federation/angular.
migrations.name: update-23-0-0-update-with-module-federation-import

migrations.description: Split @nx/angular:ngrx generator defaults in nx.json across the @nx/angular:ngrx-root-store and @nx/angular:ngrx-feature-store generators.
migrations.name: update-23-0-0-migrate-ngrx-generator-defaults

migrations.description: Rename imports of `createNodesV2` from `@nx/angular/plugin` to the canonical `createNodes` export.
migrations.name: update-23-0-0-migrate-create-nodes-v2-import

migrations.description: Rewrites the now-removed deep `@nx/angular/src/utils`, `@nx/angular/src/generators/utils` and `@nx/angular/src/generators/move/move-impl` subpath imports to the new `@nx/angular/internal` entry. The executor/builder/generator schema and impl subpaths remain available and are left untouched.
migrations.name: rewrite-angular-internal-subpath-imports

migrations.description: Rename the `ssr.experimentalPlatform` option to `ssr.platform` in `@angular/build:application`, `@angular-devkit/build-angular:application`, and `@nx/angular:application` targets, matching the Angular v22 rename.
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-rename-ssr-experimental-platform

migrations.description: Add `istanbul-lib-instrument` to `devDependencies` when a project runs unit tests with Karma (the `@angular-devkit/build-angular:karma` / `@angular/build:karma` builders, or `@angular/build:unit-test` / `@nx/angular:unit-test` with `runner: karma`), matching the Angular v22 `add-istanbul-instrumenter` migration.
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-add-istanbul-instrumenter

migrations.description: Add the `trustProxyHeaders` option to `AngularNodeAppEngine` and `AngularAppEngine` instantiations in SSR server files, matching the Angular v22 `trust-proxy-headers` migration.
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-add-trust-proxy-headers

migrations.description: Add `@angular/build` to `devDependencies` when a project uses the `@nx/angular:application` or `@nx/angular:unit-test` executor, or an `@angular/build:*` executor, and it is not already installed. These executors import `@angular/build` directly at runtime, but it has only ever been available transitively via `@angular-devkit/build-angular`, which is not reliable across package managers.
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-add-angular-build

migrations.description: Remove the `extendedDiagnostics` Angular compiler option from tsconfig files where `strictTemplates` resolves to `false`. Angular v22's `strict-templates-default` and `strict-safe-navigation-narrow` migrations can together produce this combination, which the Angular compiler rejects (`extendedDiagnostics` requires `strictTemplates` to be enabled).
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-remove-conflicting-extended-diagnostics

migrations.description: Rewrites imports of `@nx/workspace/src/utilities/typescript/compilation` to `@nx/js/internal`, where the module now lives.
migrations.name: 23-0-0-move-typescript-compilation-import

migrations.description: Replace usage of `getJestProjects` with `getJestProjectsAsync`.
migrations.name: replace-getJestProjects-with-getJestProjectsAsync-v21

migrations.description: Remove the previously deprecated and unused `tsConfig` option from the `@nx/jest:jest` executor.
migrations.name: remove-tsconfig-option-from-jest-executor

migrations.description: Rename the CLI option `testPathPattern` to `testPathPatterns`.
migrations.name: rename-test-path-pattern

migrations.description: Convert jest.config.ts files from ESM to CJS syntax (export default -> module.exports, import -> require) for projects using CommonJS resolution to ensure correct loading under Node.js type-stripping.
migrations.name: convert-jest-config-to-cjs

migrations.description: Rewrites `@nx/jest/src/*` subpath imports now that the `./src/*` subpath is no longer exposed by `@nx/jest`'s exports map. Named imports/exports of public symbols are routed to `@nx/jest` and the rest to the new `@nx/jest/internal` entry; `require`, dynamic `import` and `jest.mock` calls reference the whole module and are routed to `@nx/jest/internal`.
migrations.name: rewrite-jest-internal-subpath-imports

migrations.description: Replaces the removed `jestProjectGenerator` export from `@nx/jest` with its replacement `configurationGenerator`.
migrations.name: rewrite-jest-project-generator

migrations.description: Migrate the deprecated `setupFile` option of the `@nx/jest:jest` executor: push the file path into `setupFilesAfterEnv` in the project's Jest config and remove the option from `project.json` and `nx.json` target defaults.
migrations.name: migrate-jest-executor-setup-file

migrations.description: Migrate the deprecated `skipSetupFile` option of the `@nx/jest:configuration` generator stored as a default in `nx.json` or per-project `project.json` to `setupFile: 'none'` (when `true`) or remove it (when `false`).
migrations.name: migrate-jest-configuration-skip-setup-file

migrations.description: Rename imports of `createNodesV2` from `@nx/jest/plugin` to the canonical `createNodes` export.
migrations.name: update-23-0-0-migrate-create-nodes-v2-import

migrations.description: Add missing inputs to @nx/eslint:lint executor target defaults
migrations.name: update-executor-lint-inputs

migrations.description: Rewrites `@nx/eslint/src/*` subpath imports now that the `./src/*` subpath is no longer exposed by `@nx/eslint`'s exports map. Named imports/exports of public symbols are routed to `@nx/eslint` and the rest to the new `@nx/eslint/internal` entry; `require`, dynamic `import` and `jest.mock` calls reference the whole module and are routed to `@nx/eslint/internal`.
migrations.name: rewrite-eslint-internal-subpath-imports

migrations.description: Rename imports of `createNodesV2` from `@nx/eslint/plugin` to the canonical `createNodes` export.
migrations.name: update-23-0-0-migrate-create-nodes-v2-import

migrations.description: Handle typescript-eslint rules removed in v8 in ESLint flat configs, since referencing a removed rule stops the config from loading. Deletes the removed formatting/extension rules (e.g. @typescript-eslint/no-extra-semi) and rewrites the safe 1:1 renames (no-throw-literal -> only-throw-error, no-useless-template-literals -> no-unnecessary-template-expression) to preserve enforcement.
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-remove-removed-typescript-eslint-extension-rules

migrations.description: Migrate the removed @typescript-eslint/ban-types rule to its v8 successors (no-empty-object-type, no-unsafe-function-type, no-wrapper-object-types), whose options do not map 1:1 - so it is driven by an AI prompt rather than a deterministic codemod.
migrations.name: update-23-1-0-migrate-ban-types-rule

migrations.description: Rewrites imports from `@nx/cypress/src/*` to either the public `@nx/cypress` entry (for re-exported symbols) or `@nx/cypress/internal` (for everything else). The `./src/*` wildcard was removed from the package's exports map.
migrations.name: rewrite-internal-subpath-imports

migrations.description: Rename imports of `createNodesV2` from `@nx/cypress/plugin` to the canonical `createNodes` export.
migrations.name: update-23-0-0-migrate-create-nodes-v2-import

migrations.description: Set `justInTimeCompile: false` in webpack component testing Cypress configs on Cypress 14+, where it defaults to true and can intermittently run 0 tests in CI.
migrations.name: disable-webpack-ct-just-in-time-compile
